series.name: Quattro / MultiPlus — special LED indications (2-LED simultaneous patterns)
series.notes: Distinct from the numbered VE.Bus codes: these are non-numbered, two-LED-SIMULTANEOUS patterns. Crucial caveat carried verbatim in the source: if the 'inverter on' LED flashes in PHASE OPPOSITION to these patterns, it is a VE.Bus error code, not a special indication - look it up in the relevant VE.Bus series. Identical wording in Quattro 120 V, MultiPlus 230 V and Quattro-II/MP-II 230 V manuals.

aliases: Bulk and absorption LEDs flash simultaneously

title.en: Bulk + absorption flash together - voltage sense error
title.ur: Bulk aur absorption saath flash - voltage sense error

meaning.en: Voltage sense error. The voltage at the sense connection deviates more than 7 V from the device's main terminals - usually a connection error. The device stays in normal operation.
meaning.ur: Voltage sense error. Sense connection par voltage device ke main terminals se 7 V se zyada different hai - aam tor par connection error. Device normal chalta rehta hai.

causes.en: Voltage sense lead connected to the wrong point or open circuit
causes.ur: Voltage sense lead galat jagah jury ya khuli hui hai

causes.en: Sense wiring disconnected or its fuse open
causes.ur: Sense wiring disconnect hai ya us ka fuse khul gaya hai

solutions.en: Measure between the sense terminal and the battery negative; the difference must be under 7 V.
solutions.ur: Sense terminal aur battery negative ke darmiyan voltage nikaalein; farq 7 V se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Trace the sense lead end to end and reseat every terminal; check the sense fuse.
solutions.ur: Sense lead ko sifar tak trace karein aur har terminal dobara lagaayein; sense fuse bhi check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the polarity of the sense connections before restoring power.
solutions.ur: Power wapas chalane se pehle sense connections ki polarity confirm karein.

notes.en: If the 'inverter on' LED flashes in phase OPPOSITION to this pattern, it is a VE.Bus error code instead - cross-reference the device's VE.Bus series.
notes.ur: Agar 'inverter on' LED is pattern ke saath phase OPPOSITION mein flash kare to ye VE.Bus error code hai - device ke VE.Bus series mein dekhein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.2 Special LED indications

aliases: Absorption and float LEDs flash simultaneously

title.en: Absorption + float flash together - temp sensor fault
title.ur: Absorption aur float saath flash - temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: The measured battery temperature is an extremely unlikely value, so the sensor is probably defective or badly connected. The device stays in normal operation.
meaning.ur: Measured battery temperature aik ajeeb value hai, is liye sensor ya to kharab hai ya ghalat se jury hua hai. Device normal chalta rehta hai.

causes.en: Temperature sensor connected to the wrong terminals or not connected
causes.ur: Temperature sensor galat terminals par jury ya bilkul nahi jury

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance with a multimeter against the Victron temperature-sensor spec table.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se sensor ki resistance nikaal kar Victron sensor spec table se compare karein.

solutions.en: Pull the temperature sensor plug out of the unit and watch for about 1 minute.
solutions.ur: Temperature sensor plug nikaalein aur taqreeb aik minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If charging behaves normally with the plug out, the sensor should be replaced.
solutions.ur: Agar plug nikaal kar charging normal chale to sensor badal dena chahiye.

solutions.en: Verify sensor polarity; reversed leads can read as an impossible value.
solutions.ur: Sensor ki polarity check karein; ulti leads aik mumkin na value dikha deti hain.

notes.en: If the 'inverter on' LED flashes in phase OPPOSITION to this pattern, it is a VE.Bus error code instead.
notes.ur: Agar 'inverter on' LED is pattern ke saath phase OPPOSITION mein flash kare to ye VE.Bus error code hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.2 Special LED indications

aliases: Mains on flashes and there is no output voltage

title.en: Mains on flashes, no output voltage
title.ur: Mains on flash, magar output voltage nahi

meaning.en: The device is in 'charger only' mode with mains present. It is either rejecting the mains supply or still synchronising to it.
meaning.ur: Device 'charger only' mode mein hai aur mains maujood hai. Ya to mains supply reject kar raha hai ya abhi synchronize ho raha hai.

causes.en: Normal 'charger only' position of the front rocker switch
causes.ur: Front rocker switch ki normal 'charger only' position

causes.en: Mains supply rejected - voltage, frequency or phase not acceptable
causes.ur: Mains supply reject hui - voltage, frequency ya phase qubool nahi

causes.en: Unit still synchronising to the incoming supply
causes.ur: Unit abhi incoming supply se synchronize ho raha hai

solutions.en: Check the rocker switch is set to 'charger only' and not 'off'.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke rocker switch 'charger only' par hai, 'off' par nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the incoming AC with a multimeter and confirm it is inside the configured window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se aane wala AC measure karein aur check karein ke woh configured window mein hai.

solutions.en: Switch briefly to 'on' and see whether the inverter picks up and the mains LED steadies.
solutions.ur: MOMENT ke liye 'on' par karein aur dekhein ke inverter chalta hai aur mains LED steady ho jata hai.
